rationale: The slice is a real operational vertical slice rather than a cosmetic dashboard: it renders live Annweiler drafts, fails closed before migration, rechecks admin identity before every privileged action, publishes only through an atomic service-role RPC, records audit data, and models one city in multiple regional contexts. Automated and browser evidence satisfy the T003 package. Booking work may begin.
accepted_evidence: 56/56 repository tests pass, including seven city review contract/security tests.
Next.js production build and lint pass.
Authenticated browser walkthrough rendered the global queue and Burgentagung detail from live data.
The missing migration state blocks all publication and clearly explains why.
The SQL publish gate rejects stale/non-HTTPS sources, blocking issues, unverified end times, invalid expiry, and non-draft events.
carry_forward_findings: Before controlled migration application, make the Annweiler pilot updates replay-safe so rerunning the file cannot downgrade a later human decision.
Retire the pre-existing community route's invented start-plus-two-hours end time.
Align the TypeScript gate with SQL by checking expiresAt >= endsAt and rejecting materially future source-check timestamps.
Do not repair or rewrite remote Supabase migration history blindly; use a targeted reviewed application path.
Regional public aggregation and canonical URL evidence remains for the Annweiler public-integration phase.

next_worker_package.objective: Implement a complete Stripe Connect test-mode booking core and close the carried review safety gaps: replay-safe review seed, no invented community end time, booking/provider/offer/inventory/payment/audit schema, transaction-safe hold RPCs, reviewed offer publication, test-only Connect onboarding, destination-charge Checkout with explicit application fee, signature-verified idempotent webhook processing, cancellation/refund state model, admin test workflow, and automated verification.
next_worker_package.charge_model: Use Stripe Connect destination charges in test mode behind an explicit strategy field. Benefitsi is the platform-facing booking experience and records the application fee. Live activation, merchant-of-record, tax, payout, refund, and chargeback ownership remain owner/legal decisions.
next_worker_package.security_boundary: Stripe secret and webhook secret stay server-only and must be sk_test/whsec values. Agents receive only redacted operational status and may never onboard KYC, publish offers, refund, change payout routing, or activate live mode.
next_worker_package.migration_boundary: Create a new canonical booking migration. Do not run broad db push while remote history differs. Controlled application is a later explicit operational step unless a safe single-file path is proven.

production_blockers: No live Stripe activation is authorized.
Merchant-of-record, tax, cancellation terms, refunds, disputes and payout liability need owner/legal acceptance before production.
